title: City — GIS & location
body: At the largest scale I build digital twins on open 3DBAG and point-cloud data, and location-based AR anchored to the real world with Visual Positioning Systems and centimetre-accurate RTK GPS.

title: Room — games, apps & websites
body: At human scale I build the experiences people step into — VR training, games, apps and websites, from a training simulator to hyper-casual mobile hits.

title: Chip — tools, CV & data
body: At the smallest scale I build the tools, computer vision, AI and data plumbing underneath — cross-platform AR frameworks, synthetic data, LLM-driven characters and the backends that hold it together.
